items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 25 at 2:40AM EDT until September 26 at 11:00AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 15 to 25 knots with gusts up to 30 knots
and seas 7 to 10 feet.

* WHERE...Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 0-20 nm
and Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM EDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
